risk_statement: Customer pricing contracts or drawings may be exposed to an unapproved model
required_pilot_control: Approved enterprise environment data classification access boundaries and logging

risk_statement: Generated product compatibility guidance may be wrong or incomplete
existing_control: Product specialist review for complex quotations
required_pilot_control: Restrict pilot to retrieval and drafting with source display confidence flags and mandatory specialist approval

risk_statement: Generated price or discount may bypass delegated authority
required_pilot_control: No autonomous pricing decision and deterministic approval routing

risk_statement: Incorrect or unauthorised output may be sent to a customer
required_pilot_control: Human release remains mandatory and external sending disabled in pilot

risk_statement: Shared accounts may prevent attribution and least privilege
required_pilot_control: Named accounts role-based access and periodic review

risk_statement: Old product sheets or prior quotations may be retrieved
required_pilot_control: Approved-source registry version metadata expiry and owner

risk_statement: Employees may resist or misuse the pilot due to job-loss concern
required_pilot_control: Transparent role design training feedback and no individual performance use without policy

risk_statement: Users may accept plausible output without verification
required_pilot_control: Source-linked output verification training and sampled review

risk_statement: Pilot design may become dependent on one provider or proprietary workflow
required_pilot_control: Provider abstraction export rights and documented replacement path

risk_statement: Capacity and potential margin may be represented as cash benefit
required_pilot_control: Separate value classes observed-use metrics and approved benefit verification

risk_statement: Pilot may slow quotation or customer service during deployment
required_pilot_control: Phased cohort fallback and stop threshold

risk_statement: Retrieved documents or messages may instruct the agent to leak or alter behaviour
required_pilot_control: Untrusted-input isolation content filtering tool policy and adversarial testing
